actions.description: Execute multiple independent Salesforce REST subrequests in one batch call
actions.name: composite-batch-request

apiVersion.description: Salesforce API version. Defaults to v57.0. Example: "v57.0"

haltOnError.description: If true, stop processing subrequests after a failure. Defaults to false.

method.description: HTTP method for the subrequest. Example: "GET"

url.description: URL path for the subrequest (without the instance URL). Example: "v57.0/sobjects/Account/001D000000K0fXOIAZ"

richInput.description: Request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests

binaryPartName.description: Name of the binary part for multipart requests

binaryPartNameAlias.description: Alias for the binary part name

batchRequests.description: Array of subrequests to execute (1-25 requests)

hasErrors.description: True if any subrequest resulted in an error

statusCode.description: HTTP status code for this subrequest

result.description: Response body from this subrequest, which varies by endpoint

results.description: Results for each subrequest in the order they were submitted

actions.description: Execute a dependent graph of subrequests in one composite graph call. Supports up to 500 subrequests across multiple graphs with automatic rollback on failure.
actions.name: composite-graph-request

actions.description: Execute multiple Salesforce REST subrequests in one composite call.

actions.description: Create a Salesforce sObject record for a specified object type.
actions.name: create-record

actions.description: Create multiple sObject records in one collection request.
actions.name: create-sobject-collection

allOrNone.description: Indicates whether to roll back the entire request when any object fails (true) or continue with other objects (false). Defaults to false.

type.description: The sObject type for this record. Example: "Account", "Contact", "Opportunity"

items.description: An sObject record. Must include attributes.type. Additional fields depend on the sObject type.

records.description: List of sObject records to create. Up to 200 records.

apiVersion.description: API version to use (e.g., "v63.0"). If not provided, uses the connection default.

id.description: The ID of the created record, if successful.

success.description: Whether the record was created successfully.

errors.description: List of errors if the record creation failed.

results.description: List of SaveResult objects corresponding to each input record, in the same order.

actions.description: Delete a Salesforce sObject record by type and record ID.

sobject.description: The type of sObject to delete. Example: "Account", "Contact", "Opportunity"

recordId.description: The Salesforce record ID to delete. Example: "0015000000VALDtAAP"

actions.description: Delete multiple records in one sObject collection request.
actions.name: delete-sobject-collection

api_version.description: API version to use (e.g., "v62.0"). If not provided, the latest version will be discovered.

sObjectName.description: The type of sObject to delete (e.g., "Account", "Contact", "Opportunity").

ids.description: Array of record IDs to delete.

allOrNone.description: If true, all deletions must succeed for any to succeed (transactional). If false, partial success is allowed.

actions.description: List available sObject types and global metadata for the org.

api_version.description: API version to use (e.g., "v60.0"). If omitted, uses the default version from the connection.

encoding.description: Character encoding used by the org.

max_batch_size.description: Maximum number of records that can be processed in a single batch.

custom.description: Whether the sObject is a custom object.

keyPrefix.description: Record ID prefix for this sObject type.

labelPlural.description: Plural display label for the sObject.

activateable.description: Whether the sObject can be activated.

createable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be created.

deletable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be deleted.

updateable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be updated.

queryable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be queried.

feedEnabled.description: Whether feeds are enabled for this sObject.

mergeable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be merged.

replicateable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be replicated.

retrieveable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be retrieved.

searchLayoutable.description: Whether the sObject supports search layouts.

searchable.description: Whether records of this sObject can be searched.

triggerable.description: Whether triggers are supported for this sObject.

deprecatedAndHidden.description: Whether the sObject is deprecated and hidden.

isSubtype.description: Whether the sObject is a subtype.

idEnabled.description: Whether IDs are enabled for this sObject.

sobjects.description: List of available sObject types and their metadata.

quickActionName.description: The API name of the quick action. Example: "Account.New_Account"

sObject.description: The name of the sObject to retrieve metadata for. Example: "Account"

name.description: The API name of the sObject.

label.description: The display label for the sObject.

labelPlural.description: The plural display label for the sObject.

keyPrefix.description: The key prefix for record IDs of this type.

updateable.description: Whether records of this type can be updated.

createable.description: Whether records of this type can be created.

deletable.description: Whether records of this type can be deleted.

queryable.description: Whether records of this type can be queried.

custom.description: Whether this is a custom object.

rowTemplate.description: URL template for accessing a specific record.

uiEditTemplate.description: URL template for editing a record in the UI.

uiDetailTemplate.description: URL template for viewing a record in the UI.

fields.description: Metadata for fields defined on this sObject.

name.description: The API name of the field.

label.description: The display label for the field.

type.description: The data type of the field.

length.description: The maximum length of the field.

updateable.description: Whether the field can be updated.

createable.description: Whether the field can be set on create.

custom.description: Whether this is a custom field.

nillable.description: Whether the field allows null values.

recentItems.description: Recently accessed records of this type.

apiVersion.description: Salesforce API version. Example: "v60.0". If omitted, uses the default version from the connection.

actionName.description: The API name of the quick action

label.description: The display label of the quick action

targetObject.description: The target sObject for the quick action

targetParentField.description: The parent field for the quick action

count.description: Total number of quick actions returned

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default varies by API version.

actions.description: Run a parameterized search request across Salesforce objects.

sobjects.description: Array of sObject types to search across. Example: ["Account", "Contact"]

fields.description: Fields to return for each sObject. Example: ["Id", "Name", "Email"]

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-2000).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

where.description: Additional WHERE clause to filter results.

actions.description: Run a SOQL query that also includes deleted and archived records.
actions.name: query-all-records

query.description: SOQL query string. Example: "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account"

apiVersion.description: Salesforce API version. Example: "v60.0". If omitted, uses the connection default.

version.description: Salesforce API version. Example: "v63.0". Defaults to v63.0.

soql.description: SOQL query string. Example: "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10"

actions.description: Continue a SOQL query using a nextRecordsUrl locator
actions.name: retrieve-query-more

actions.description: Update a record by external ID field and value.
actions.name: update-record-by-external-id

sObject.description: The sObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c). Example: "Account"

externalIdField.description: The API name of the external ID field. Example: "customExtIdField__c"

externalId.description: The external ID value to look up. Example: "ext-123"

fields.description: The field values to update on the record. Example: { "Name": "Acme Corp", "Phone": "555-1234" }

id.description: The Salesforce ID of the updated record. Only returned if the record was created (when updateOnly is false).

actions.description: Partially update a Salesforce record by object type and record ID.

record_id.description: The Salesforce record ID to update. Example: "0015000000XYZABC".

fields.description: Fields to update on the record. Only provided fields will be updated.

errors.description: Error messages if the update failed.

actions.description: Update multiple records in one sObject collection request

id.description: The record ID to update. Example: "001xx000003DHP0AAO"

records.description: Array of records to update. Each record must include attributes.type, id, and the fields to update.

created.description: True if the record was created, false if updated.

errors.description: Error details if the operation failed.
